real_flaw: ERC-777 hook reentrancy into balance-based pricing (no reentrancy guard)
flag_gate: pool ETH balance drained below threshold only reachable via the ERC-777 tokensToSend reentrancy; FlagVault.claim requires pool drained AND keccak256(flag) == expectedHash
threshold: pool ETH <= 2.5e18 (attacker holds B=T tokens; legit single swap leaves pool at ~5 ETH)

contracts.ImBTC777: OpenZeppelin ERC777 v4.9.6 (stock) + constructor mint; ERC-1820 hooks (tokensToSend fires before state update)
contracts.Exchange: Uniswap-V1-style ETH/token pool, output priced from token.balanceOf(this) & address(this).balance, NO reentrancy guard
contracts.ExchangeSafe: same pool with OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard (negative/fix variant)
contracts.FlagVault: claim(taskId,flag) gated on address(pool).balance <= drainedThreshold AND keccak256(flag) == expectedHash
